user.title: Set up an EYOCEAN RF desk lamp
user.description: Choose an existing 433.92 MHz OOK transmitter and enter the identity decoded from your own remote. Setup never transmits. This integration provides command buttons, not confirmed lamp state.

data.name: Lamp name
data.remote_id: Remote ID (1–4 hex digits, optional 0x prefix)
data.xor_key: XOR key (1–2 hex digits, optional 0x prefix)
data.swap_night_timer: Swap Night light and Timer command codes

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure EYOCEAN lamp
reconfigure.description: Change the transmitter, remote identity or command repetition. No test transmission is sent.

data.name: Lamp name
data.remote_id: Remote ID (1–4 hex digits, optional 0x prefix)
data.xor_key: XOR key (1–2 hex digits, optional 0x prefix)
data.swap_night_timer: Swap Night light and Timer command codes

error.invalid_remote_id: Enter a nonzero remote ID with at most four hexadecimal digits.
error.invalid_xor_key: Enter an XOR key with at most two hexadecimal digits. Zero is valid.
error.invalid_repeats: Enter a whole number from 1 to 20.
error.invalid_transmitter: Select an available compatible RF transmitter from the list.

abort.no_compatible_transmitters: No compatible 433.92 MHz OOK transmitter is registered. Add an RF adapter such as an ESPHome radio_frequency proxy first.
abort.already_configured: This remote ID and XOR key are already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The EYOCEAN lamp configuration has been updated.
